notes.title: Now Available - Scary Girl, 20% off!
notes.content:
Scary Girl is now available on Steam and is 20% off until April 9th at 10am Pacific Time!

In this side-scrolling action game, you play as Scarygirl – a girl who has been adopted by a giant intelligent octopus and is trying to figure out who is the man haunting her dreams. Traverse unique, extremely vibrant, colorful, and magical worlds in a seamless mix of 2D and 3D platforming action. Go it alone in single-player or grab a friend and team up in local co-op to fight alongside Bunniguru – the giant kung-fu rabbit!
